## Root cause
In `findCaseInsensitivePathRec` (/gin/tree.go), after the `if !n.wildChild { ... }` block the code must descend into the node's **wildcard child**. In gin's tree the wildcard child is always kept at the **end** of `children` (`addChild` keeps it last; `insertChild` sets `wildChild = true` after appending; `getValue` uses `n.children[len(n.children)-1]` with the comment "Handle wildcard child, which is always at the end of the array"). The buggy line used `n = n.children[0]`, i.e. it descended into the **first static child** whenever a node had several children plus a wildcard/param child. The subsequent `switch n.nType` then hit a static node (`nType == 0`) and hit `default: panic("invalid node type")` — or returned a wrong path. With only one child (the wildcard) `children[0] == children[len-1]`, which is why every pre-existing test passed and the bug was invisible.
